[[File:Slaver_snare_gun.jpg|thumb|A slaver snare gun put to use]]
A '''snare gun''', or '''slaver snare gun''', was a ranged weapon that shot an automatically-formed net around a living target. Manufactured by [[Corondexx/Legends|Corondexx]], it was favored by [[Slavery/Legends|slavers]] such as the [[Thalassian slavers/Legends|Thalassians]]<ref name="GG11">''[[Galaxy Guide 11: Criminal Organizations]]''</ref><ref name="Gundark's">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref> and the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Malak (Rodian)|Malak]].<ref name="GG11" /> It resembled the [[Snare rifle/Legends|snare rifle]] in functionality.
